Name: Olympic Archery Set
Author: QuillSnow
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]The Olympic Archery Set consists of a fast, lightweight bow and a light, razor-sharp arrow for all your competitive archery needs. Inspired by the recurve bows and carbon fibre arrows used by Olympian athletes, the weapon set makes for a speedy companion for your mining escapades. You can buy the bow and arrows from Marlon along with the recipe to craft them after obtaining a very special weapon from the desert.[/size]
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]
